get.summary: Read one registered node's egress incidents
get.description: Administrator session only; users:read automation does not authorize target resources. Makes one bounded request to the registered mTLS node under current exact-leaf and owner authorization, sharing controller network and per-peer limits. No browser-supplied URL, probes, writes, background fan-out or local fallback. The target needs a schema-17 monitor. Only its own egress_check and health_catalog incidents are returned, never its remote directory, traffic or jobs. Sampling metadata, counts and cursors belong to this egress projection. History is process-local and cleared on restart. Unknown/stale/unavailable evidence and source replacement do not prove recovery. A manual response is a snapshot, not continuing health coverage. Query fields are accepted once each, with at most 768 encoded bytes.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from this target's same boot, egress revision and state. Not a local alert or inventory cursor.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Canonical decimal without signs or leading zeroes.

200.description: A bounded snapshot of only the selected node's egress incidents. Empty without fresh applicable evidence does not mean healthy.

400.description: invalid_alert_query: unknown/duplicate field, invalid state/limit, malformed or out-of-range cursor.

409.description: alerts_changed: target boot, egress revision or state changed. Start from the first page.

502.description: egress_alerts_unsupported only for a node's fixed not_found response; alerts_unavailable for a missing monitor; other remote authorization, representation or transport failures retain a bounded code. Remote authentication failure is not a browser logout.

503.description: Local node_control_unavailable or node_busy. No remote read was admitted.

504.description: node_timeout: bounded remote exchange did not complete. No health or recovery assertion.

origin_node_id.description: Always the exact selected target node_id, not one of its managed peers.

observed_at_unix_ms.description: Most recent successful health snapshot read's display timestamp, not a successful probe.

age_millis.description: Monotonic age of that read. Null before collection; remains historical on failed reads.

collection_error.description: The latest health snapshot read failed. Other node observations do not change this flag.

monitored.description: An egress observation source is configured on the target; not a healthy result.

dropped.description: Discarded egress observations/history only, not other nodes' incidents.

EgressAlertPage.description: Filter before counting and paging. Active uses source/resource order; recent uses latest terminal transition first. Sampling age is not a probe freshness policy. History shares the target monitor's bounded retention, so nonzero dropped means incomplete history. No durable import, notification or remediation.
